ci_notes: lake shake --add-public --keep-implied --keep-prefix exits 1 across the whole repository (~2956 lines of output, hundreds of files). The overwhelming majority of hits are a pre-existing, repo-wide pattern unrelated to tasks 539/540/541/543/547: shake recommends removing `import Cslib.Init` from files where it sees no directly-referenced declaration, even though CONTRIBUTING.md/checkInitImports (which passed cleanly) mandates the import on every file -- a structural tension between the two required CI checks, not a defect introduced by these tasks. Of the changed files in this vet's scope, 4 are flagged: Cslib/Logics/Propositional/ProofSystemEquivalence.lean, Cslib/Logics/Propositional/SequentCalculus/LM/Completeness.lean, and Cslib/Logics/Propositional/SequentCalculus/LM/Soundness.lean (all task 547) show only the universal Cslib.Init false positive; Cslib/Logics/Modal/Metalogic/Intuitionistic/CanonicalModel.lean (task 540) additionally shows two substantive, task-540-attributable redundant imports (`public import Cslib.Logics.Modal.Metalogic.MCS`, `public import Cslib.Logics.Modal.Semantics.Birelational`) that appear only in docstring prose, never as used identifiers, once task 540 added `GenericMCSBridge`/`DerivationCombinators` imports to the same file. lake build, checkInitImports, lake lint, lake exe lint-style, and lake test all pass cleanly with zero warnings attributable to any of the 46 files above. Pre-existing sorries (Tableau/Intuitionistic/{Completeness,Scheme}.lean, Tableau/Minimal/Completeness.lean) and pre-existing longLine warnings (Tableau/Intuitionistic/Soundness.lean) surfaced by lake build/lake test belong to files outside this vet's scope and are unrelated to tasks 539-547.

violations.description: `lake shake --add-public --keep-implied --keep-prefix` flags `public import Cslib.Logics.Modal.Metalogic.MCS` and `public import Cslib.Logics.Modal.Semantics.Birelational` as unused (both `BFrame`/`BForces`/`MCS`-named identifiers appear only in this file's docstring prose, never as used Lean terms). Task 540 added two new imports (`GenericMCSBridge`, `DerivationCombinators`) to this file without re-running import minimization, plausibly making the older imports newly redundant.
violations.fix_hint: Run `lake shake --add-public --keep-implied --keep-prefix --fix` (or manually drop the two flagged imports) and re-verify with `lake build`.
